description: Land Acquisition - Hittetiya East, Matara D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides specific details about a particular land parcel (lot 02 in Preliminary Plan No. MR 729) being acquired for the Matara Kirala Kele Project, including location, description, ownership details, and extent. The notice serves to inform interested parties about the acquisition and compensation process, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
